meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会分步带你接入 Mattermost 机器人频道：探测已有服务器、配置 SiteURL、复制并注册适配器、创建并认证 bot、设置回调 URL、解析你的私聊，最后构建、测试、重启并验证。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 Mattermost 频道时接管。若没找到可用的服务器，它会给出 Mattermost 官方评估与部署指引，等你拿到服务器地址后再继续。

say.text: 用 use 选用探测到的本地 Mattermost 服务器
say.note: 确认后它会把该地址写成规范 base URL

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through adding a Mattermost bot channel: probing for an existing server, setting SiteURL, registering the adapter, authenticating a bot, configuring the callback URL, resolving your DM, then building, testing and restarting.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to add a Mattermost channel. If no healthy server is found, it points to Mattermost's official setup guides and waits for a server URL.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost channel; my server is https://mm.example.com
say_en.note: It probes servers first, then asks you to confirm the URL

say_en.text: Use the local Mattermost server Claude detected
say_en.note: Confirmed, it sets that address as the canonical base URL

say_en.text: Re-run add-mattermost and reuse my saved bot token and callback URL
say_en.note: On reruns it offers to reuse existing settings
